content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes street sweepers, mowers and farm equipment, not asphalt plants or their process equipment and parts."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Designs and builds asphalt plants and sells aftermarket parts and service to the same road and asphalt customers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures roofing membranes, insulation and brake components for building and vehicle markets, not asphalt plants."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Is a road-building contractor that runs its own asphalt plants, selling construction services rather than selling plant equipment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Is a plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor that resells others' products rather than making process equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors for industrial, energy and rail customers, not asphalt plants."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Makes center pivot irrigation for farmers and highway guardrails, not asphalt plants or process equipment."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes EPA-certified engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers, not asphalt plants or burner systems."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Develops and sells paints, coatings and specialty materials, a chemicals business with no equipment or asphalt plant overlap."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sells metalworking fluids, lubricants and process chemicals to steel and metal plants, not asphalt equipment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sells coatings, sealants and roofing systems plus consumer products, a materials and building business, not plant equipment."}]}
